description: This file defines the LoggerAppenderEcho class, which is a PHP-based logging appender for the log4php framework. It extends LoggerAppenderSkeleton and outputs log events using the PHP echo function. The class includes methods for appending log events, managing footer/header output, and constructors.

classes.name: LoggerAppenderEcho
classes.description: A PHP appender for log4php that outputs log events via echo, relying on a layout to format the output.

methods.name: LoggerAppenderEcho
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the appender with a name.

methods.name: activateOptions
methods.description: Method to activate options; currently does nothing.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the appender, outputting footer if necessary, and marks it as closed.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Formats and outputs a log event using echo, managing header/footer output.
